# NE High Street Heroes Awards 2026

> A regional awards programme celebrating the businesses and individuals
> revitalising high streets across the North East of England. Run by First
> Connections. Nomination and voting are free. The Gala Night is in
> February 2027 at The Hippodrome, Darlington.

The awards run across 10 categories covering retail, hospitality, community,
digital, sustainability, customer experience, emerging businesses, employers,
independents, and high streets as a whole. Anyone can nominate a North East
business or individual at no cost. Shortlisting is done by a panel of regional
experts, and winners are announced at the Gala Ceremony.

## Pages

- [Home](https://ne-hsh-awards.co.uk/): Overview of the awards, key dates, sponsors and FAQs.
- [Award Categories](https://ne-hsh-awards.co.uk/categories): All 10 categories with judging criteria for each.
- [Vote For Your Hero](https://ne-hsh-awards.co.uk/vote): How voting works, and the form to cast a vote.
- [About](https://ne-hsh-awards.co.uk/about): The story behind the awards and the First Connections team.
- [Brand Kit](https://ne-hsh-awards.co.uk/brand-kit): Official logos, posters and social graphics to download.
- [Contact](https://ne-hsh-awards.co.uk/contact): Sponsorship, media and general enquiries.

## Key facts

- Event: NE High Street Heroes Awards 2026
- Gala Night: February 2027
- Venue: The Hippodrome, Darlington, County Durham
- Region: North East England (Tees Valley, County Durham, Tyne and Wear, Northumberland)
- Organiser: First Connections
- Cost to nominate: Free
- Contact: awards@first-connections.co.uk
